testAssets.name: NVIDIA Cosmos 3 (world model / synthetic video, OpenUSD)
testAssets.kind: World model + synthetic data generation for AV training/testing (also GR00T-adjacent robotics data)
testAssets.note: Open foundation world model for generating physically-accurate simulation and data (image/video/audio and robot action). Model sizes (root repo README, authoritative; the cookbook NIM section lists conflicting 8B/32B figures): Cosmos3-Super = 64B (H200/B200/GB200), Cosmos3-Nano = 16B (RTX Pro 6000/H100/B200), Cosmos3-Edge = 4B (Jetson AGX Orin/Thor/RTX Pro 6000). Native AV conditioning: 9D autonomous-vehicle action conditioning; forward dynamics (action-conditioned future frames for AV/DROID/UMI); inverse dynamics (ego-motion trajectory recovered from AV video); Action CoT (trajectory prediction + driving-scene chain-of-causation). Inference backends: Cosmos Framework (native PyTorch, torchrun), Diffusers (Cosmos3OmniPipeline), Transformers >=5.11, TensorRT-LLM (OpenAI-compatible VisualGen server), vLLM/vLLM-Omni (OpenAI-compatible reasoning + omni generation), SGLang, NGC NIM containers (cosmos3 certified 2.0.0, reasoner 1.7.0, generator 1.0.0). Architecture: Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) + mRoPE; audio generated only together with video (stereo AAC 48 kHz); guardrails via gated nvidia/Cosmos-1.0-Guardrail; license OpenMDW-1.1; gen up to 300 frames at 256p/480p/720p (10/16/24/30 FPS). Finetune recipes (8xH100 SFT incl. Policy-DROID) + DMD2 4-step distill + export (DCP to safetensors to Diffusers). Distinguishes next-token reasoning (Trajectory, Drive2Drive, VideoPhy-2-style reasoners) from world-model generation. Cosmos Framework ships Agent Skills (.agents/skills/, .claude/skills/). AURA angle (user-confirmed): driving-scene reasoner + synthetic SA-edge scenario generator behind the dashboard sim line — taxi pull-outs, pothole swerves, unmarked intersections in OpenUSD for repeatable tests before tarmac; closes SA 'simulationSoftware' gap (importable, not SA-owned). URLs: github.com/NVIDIA/cosmos (README) + cookbooks/cosmos3 (setup + reasoner + generator + nim). Strategic alignment: Use BMW iX (TASEZ) as a primary target for high-fidelity neural reconstruction and synthetic scenario validation in the SA context.
testAssets.confidence: HIGH (official README + cookbook reviewed 2026-09-15); model sizes CONFLICT between README (16B/64B/4B, authoritative) and cookbook NIM section (8B/32B) — README adopted; local GPU requirement HIGH-GPU (Nano 16B fp8 single GPU; Super 64B multi-GPU)
